v2.ref: REAL comfyanonymous/ComfyUI @ commit 4f4f1c642ad77886a9b5716ad886cde556858a60 (PR #8384 'Update fix for potential XSS on /view', tag v0.3.40 = the actual CVE-2025-6092 fix). server.py view_image() replaces the EXTENSION blocklist with a MIME blocklist: content_type in {'text/html','text/html-sandboxed','application/xhtml+xml','text/javascript','text/css'} -> application/octet-stream ('Forces download'). evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: CVE-2025-6092 is labelled by NVD/VulDB as an 'Incomplete Fix CVE-2024-10099' in the /upload/image + /view flow. CVE-2024-10099's fix (PR #6034, merge 59d58b11) force-downloads uploaded files only when their EXTENSION is in {'.html','.htm','.js','.css'}; it computes content_type from the filename otherwise. A file uploaded with a '.xhtml' extension is not on that blocklist, so /view serves it with content_type application/xhtml+xml and an inline disposition; a browser navigating to /view parses the XHTML as a top-level document and executes its inline <script>, retaining the stored XSS. This is exactly the public PoC (superboy-zjc gist): an XHTML document uploaded via /upload/image and rendered by /view. The fix, PR #8384 ('Update fix for potential XSS on /view', tag v0.3.40), replaces the extension blocklist with a MIME blocklist {'text/html','text/html-sandboxed','application/xhtml+xml','text/javascript','text/css'}, which now includes 'application/xhtml+xml' -> the .xhtml is forced to application/octet-stream. (Incomplete fix for CVE-2024-10099.)
